educationalGoal: Students will: (1)Learn basic knowledge about taking a client-centered approach (2)Learn basic attitudes towards clinical interviews (3)Acquire verbal and non-verbal communication skills for clinical interviews
advice: This is a basic course in clinical counseling skills. We will cover the following topics: 1.Acquisition of basic knowledge of clinical counseling. 2.Training in basic clinical interview skills through role-plays 3.How to apply counseling skills

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain basic methods of clinical counseling.
Ability to understand and practice a positive attitude towards clinical counseling.
Ability to understand and apply interviewing skills: “Questioning” and “Reflection”
Ability to explain how to apply interviewing skills to clinical assessment and intervention.
Ability to discuss ethical principles for clinical psychologists.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
